summary: Slack notifications need a Slack app with a bot token, destination channels one per line with #, an optional parent message ID (dot after the 10th digit) to post in a thread, and a hex color; the app must be installed to the workspace.
questions: How do I configure Slack notifications in automation controller?
How do I post a notification into a Slack thread?
What token does the Slack notifier need?

answer_card.title: Slack notifier settings
answer_card.answer_md:
- **Token**: a Slack bot token from an app installed to your workspace.
- **Destination channels**: one per line, with `#`. To reply in a thread add the 16-digit parent message ID with a dot after the 10th digit, for example `#destination-channel, 1231257890.006423`.
- **Notification color**: a hex code such as `#3af`.
